item.title: The Future of Quality - Trends and Predictions
item.author: eterry28@gmail.com (Eric Terry)
item.description: Introduction to Software Quality Trends # Please allow me to clarify the distinction between Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC). QA is proactive and focuses on the process, while QC concentrates on inspection.
